# plotwork_organization_brand (Resource)

An organisation's brand theme: the colours its diagrams are painted in on the hosted service, in place of Plotwork's blue, violet and aqua. An organisation has one brand; destroying the resource removes it.

Needs the owner's plan to include brand themes (Pro or above), and the owner or an admin, or an organisation key with the `design:write` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The organisation's brand. secondary and accent are made from primary
# when left out; effective_secondary and effective_accent say which.
resource "plotwork_organization_brand" "acme" {
  organization = "acme"
  primary      = "#2a78d6"
  secondary    = "#7c3aed"
}

output "brand_accent" {
  value = plotwork_organization_brand.acme.effective_accent
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `primary` (String) The main brand colour, `#rrggbb` or `#rgb` in any case. It takes the place of the blue tone. Case and the short form are not a change.

### Optional

- `accent` (String) Takes the place of the aqua tone. Left out, Plotwork makes it from `primary` and it follows `primary`; `effective_accent` says which colour that is.
- `organization` (String) The slug or id of the organisation. Defaults to the provider's `organization` (or `PLOTWORK_ORG`). Changing it, or the provider's value when this is left out, replaces the resource in the new organisation.
- `secondary` (String) Takes the place of the violet tone. Left out, Plotwork makes it from `primary` and it follows `primary`; `effective_secondary` says which colour that is.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the hosted service paints with the brand. False when the owner's plan no longer includes brand themes; the brand is kept.
- `effective_accent` (String) The accent colour Plotwork paints with: `accent`, or the one made from `primary`.
- `effective_primary` (String) The primary colour as Plotwork stores it, lower-case `#rrggbb`.
- `effective_secondary` (String) The secondary colour Plotwork paints with: `secondary`, or the one made from `primary`.
- `id` (String) The organisation, as configured: an organisation has one brand.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An organisation's brand, by the organisation's slug or id.
terraform import plotwork_organization_brand.acme acme
```
